issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing calc_val to return the value 42 in the EAX register (problem_statement.md lines 21-22). The solution repository implements calc_val but moves 42 into EBX (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 9-11: "mov ebx, 42"), so the solution does not place the return value in the specified register. This contradicts the specification and would confuse students (and any automated checks) about which register should contain the result.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the solution implementation of calc_val so it places 42 into EAX before returning (e.g. change 'mov ebx, 42' to 'mov eax, 42'). Update the comment to reflect the correct return register.
